fix: But Huntress emphasised that there are actions which can be taken to reduce the risk from these kinds of campaigns. “Conditional Access Policies (CAP) can help fill some of the security gaps that MFA can't, as long as they're appropriately implemented. Businesses setting up CAPs should require MFA (or block) for All Users, All Cloud Apps, and All Client App types, unconditionally,” said Huntress. If companies suspect a token replay compromise, it is advised that they revoke the sessions and reset the password, perform an audit of Entra devices and MFA methods and review inbox rules to identify if anything has been changed.
impact: Researchers at Huntress observed the threat actor behind the campaign make at least 200,000 login attempts, which included 497 successful sign-ins. In many cases, the attackers were inside environments just minutes after stealing the tokens. For example, in several observed incidents, the attackers wiped the victim’s MFA settings and added their own phone to the account user, so a simple password reset wouldn’t lock them out, because now the attacker had their own authenticator app for the environment.
